# FiveByFive

FiveByFive is a free, open-source trainer for the NATO and ICAO phonetic alphabet. It teaches the code words used to spell letters over radio, along with common radio phrases and spelling drills.

## Core surfaces
- Letters: learn the code word for every letter from A to Z
- Codes: radio phrases and pronunciation across five difficulty levels
- Spelling: spell words using code words, from short words to tricky ones
- Four game modes in each training: pick, reverse pick, input and reverse input
- Blitz and Gauntlet: timed runs for each training
- Progress tracking: stats, mastery and practice history saved in the browser

## Best entry points
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/kana
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/kanji
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/vocabulary
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/faq
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/how-to-use
- https://fivebyfive.vercel.app/resources

## Retrieval hints
- Learn the phonetic alphabet or practice code words: /kana
- Learn radio phrases such as roger, wilco and mayday: /kanji
- Practice spelling words in code words: /vocabulary
- Understand the game modes: /how-to-use

## Notes
- Route folders still use the upstream names kana, kanji and vocabulary. They now serve Letters, Codes and Spelling.
- Forked from lingdojo/kana-dojo. Source at https://github.com/frteddz/FiveByFive.
- Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and next-intl.
